statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient's diagnoses are I48.0 and I48.91
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is clinically necessary to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden
Correlating symptoms with rhythm disturbances requires continuous rhythm capture
